summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Cycnus the son of Poseidon or Ares, whom Heracles slew, and of other swan-linked figures in Greek myth.

story.text: Apollodorus names Cycnus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Acarnan and before Pseras in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
